**[Suggestion]** `sourceType` is passed unconditionally to `listWorkspaceSessions`, while `WebShellSidebar.tsx` gates the same parameter on the `session_source_metadata` capability (`sourceMetadataEnabled`). When connected to a daemon that does not advertise this feature, sidebar session lists correctly omit `sourceType`, but every expanded `WorkspaceSection` still sends `sourceType: 'default'` unconditionally — potentially causing failures or inconsistent display.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`sourceType` 被无条件传递给 `listWorkspaceSessions`，而 `WebShellSidebar.tsx` 中同样的参数是根据 `session_source_metadata` 能力位有条件传递的。当连接的 daemon 不支持该能力时，每个展开的 `WorkspaceSection` 仍然无条件发送 `sourceType: 'default'`，可能导致请求失败或显示不一致。
</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**[P1] Do not rely on opaque host components forwarding this internal selector.** The public renderer accepts arbitrary `ReactNode`, but the proxy can find an action only when `cloneElement`\u0027s `data-pane-header-action-index` reaches the DOM. A normal host component such as `function ShareButton() { return <button onClick={onShare}>Share</button>; }` ignores that injected prop. I reproduced this on `97ef298d`: the inline action works, but after collapse the menu label is the fallback `Action`, `querySelector` returns `null`, and selecting the menu item calls `onShare` zero times. This is the primary integration shape for a render slot, and the API does not document or type-require prop forwarding. Please make the proxy operate on a wrapper/actual rendered interactive descendant, or replace the opaque-node API with structured action descriptors; documenting a prop-forwarding requirement would still leave existing/custom components silently broken.

**[Suggestion]** `actionMenuLabel` returns raw `ReactNode` children when a host action is an icon-only button with no `aria-label` or `title` — the overflow menu item renders an unlabeled icon with no accessible name.

**Failure scenario:** A host passes `<button type="button"><ShareIcon /></button>` (icon-only, no text). In inline layout the icon is self-explanatory; when collapsed into the overflow menu, `actionMenuLabel` returns `<ShareIcon />` as the menu item's content. The `role="menuitem"` element has no accessible name (SVGs typically carry `aria-hidden="true"`), so a screen reader announces an empty item.

**Suggested fix:** Filter out non-primitive children — only return `props.children` when it is a `string` or `number`:

```suggestion
  if (
    props.children != null &&
    props.children !== false &&
    (typeof props.children === 'string' || typeof props.children === 'number')
  ) {
    return props.children;
  }
```

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Suggestion]** 当宿主 action 是没有 `aria-label` 或 `title` 的纯图标按钮时，`actionMenuLabel` 会返回原始 `ReactNode` children——溢出菜单项将渲染无文字标签的图标，缺少可访问名称。

**失败场景：** 宿主传入 `<button type="button"><ShareIcon /></button>`（纯图标，无文字）。行内布局下图标一目了然；折叠到溢出菜单后，`actionMenuLabel` 将 `<ShareIcon />` 作为菜单项内容返回。`role="menuitem"` 元素没有可访问名称（SVG 通常带 `aria-hidden="true"`），屏幕阅读器播报为空项。

**修复建议：** 过滤掉非原始类型的 children——仅在 `props.children` 为 `string` 或 `number` 时返回。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

**[Suggestion]** The fallback `'Action'` string is hardcoded English, bypassing i18n. Every other user-facing string in this component (`splitView.morePaneActions`, `splitView.closePane`, etc.) is localized via `t()`.

**Failure scenario:** A host action element has no `aria-label`, no `title`, and non-string children. In a Chinese locale, the overflow menu item displays the untranslated English "Action".

**Suggested fix:** Accept a localized fallback string from the call site where `t` is available:

```suggestion
  return defaultLabel;
```

And update the call site in the overflow menu to pass `t('splitView.defaultActionLabel')` (or a suitable existing key) as a second argument to `actionMenuLabel`.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

**[Suggestion]** 兜底字符串 `'Action'` 是硬编码英文，绕过了 i18n。组件中所有其他面向用户的字符串（`splitView.morePaneActions`、`splitView.closePane` 等）都通过 `t()` 做了国际化。

**失败场景：** 宿主 action 元素没有 `aria-label`、没有 `title`，且 children 为非字符串。在中文环境下，溢出菜单项显示未翻译的英文 "Action"。

**修复建议：** 在拥有 `t` 的调用处传入本地化的兜底字符串，作为 `actionMenuLabel` 的第二个参数。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_
